7735990.baseName: Habitat 5ft Premium Potted Artificial Christmas Tree
7735990.variantName: Habitat 5ft Premium Potted Artificial Christmas Tree
7735990.sourceDescription: Bring the magic of Christmas into your home with this 5ft faux Christmas tree from Habitat. It's packed with lush, full branches and 772 3D needle tips that create a realistic, just-cut look without the hassle of watering or pine needle clean-up. The tree sits in a textured, woven-effect pot that adds a warm, rustic finish to your festive display. Fixed branches mean you can assemble it quickly and enjoy instant seasonal charm year after year. The polypropylene construction keeps it looking fresh season after season, while the plastic stand gives it a stable base to hold all your favourite decorations. You'll get plenty of space across the branches for twinkling lights and treasured baubles, with the brand suggesting around 480 lights for this size tree. It's designed for indoor use and comes with fixed branches that make setup straightforward, so you can focus on the fun part of decorating with the family. . x92k3s26.variantName: Christmas Tree World 80cm Blue Metallic Inflatable Mirror Ball - Pack of 1
x92k3s26.sourceDescription: Introducing the 80cm Inflatable Mirror Display Ball in Blue, a striking and versatile decorative solution designed to create instant impact in retail environments, commercial venues, events, exhibitions, and the home. Featuring a sleek mirror finish, this inflatable display ball reflects light and surroundings beautifully, making it ideal for eye-catching shop windows, visual merchandising, brand activations, and large-scale installations. A key advantage for commercial users is ease of storage. Once deflated or with the air removed using a compatible electric pump the display ball folds down to a fraction of its inflated size, making off-season storage simple and space-efficient. Manufactured from fire-retardant materials, the Inflatable Mirror Display Ball is suitable for use in commercial and public spaces. It is inflated once, sealed securely, and displayed without the need for a continuous power supply. Product Features • Size: 80cm (other sizes available) • Colour: Blue (other colours available) • Finish: High-gloss mirror effect • Material: Durable inflatable construction • Fire-resistant: Fire retardant material • Indoor & outdoor use • Installation options: Floor-standing, ceiling-hung, wall-mounted or secured to ground • Inflation: Inflated once and sealed no continuous air supply required • Storage: Fully deflates to take up minimal storage space • Pump: Electric air pump not included • Oversized gold bauble caps not included • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB

zrqpdcbq.sourceDescription: Create a festive focal point around your Christmas tree with this pre-lit wooden tree skirt featuring a charming Northern Lights Snowman scene. The natural brown surround showcases decorative cut-out snowmen, fir trees and stars, illuminated by multicolour RGB LED lights. Choose from a range of lighting effects using the included remote control or the cable-mounted button. Designed for easy assembly, the panels slot together around your tree before or after decorating. Suitable for most 6ft to 8ft Christmas trees, it accommodates tree stands up to 78cm diagonally, depending on stand shape. Powered by a low-voltage mains transformer for indoor use only. Features: Northern Lights Snowman scene with cut-out snowman, trees and stars. Pre-lit with multicolour RGB LED lights. Multiple lighting effects with remote control included. Easy slot-together assembly. Suitable for most 6ft to 8ft Christmas trees. Fits tree stands up to 78cm diagonally Dimensions: H25 x W60 x D60cm. Box dimensions: H60 x W10 x D27cm. Weight: 3kg. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB
